rationale: Attempt uses the true background and directional nearest markers. The rule rotates each 6's displacement around its aligned 1 into a 7's displacement; none of the keys encodes the required distances.

Attempt distinguishes colour and hole count, including the erased blue marker. The large object's target colour depends on the separate blue marker's shape, which no available object property records.

Attempt pools rotated corridor neighbourhoods through eight-neighbour counts. Correct filling requires following the corridor and its blocking marker; local keys cannot distinguish identical neighbourhoods on opposite sides of that marker.

Attempt enables crosses for every nonzero source colour, fixing omitted colour 8. Crossings must become 2 while individual rays retain their source colours; the template has no intersection-dependent paint rule.

Attempt uses local shape instead of absolute modulo coordinates. In the first demonstration, pixels (1,2) and (1,3), indexed from zero, have identical 3x3 patterns but require 8 and 2. The other keys also collapse required distinctions.

Attempt learns local boundary patterns. The rule fills each object's bounding rectangle; available keys lack component identity and component extrema, so they cannot consistently distinguish rectangle interiors from exterior zeros.

Attempt includes both halves' occupied positions. The required output preserves matching colours and assigns distinct colours to first-only and second-only pixels; every supported operation emits only one nonzero colour.

Attempt lowers retention while preserving sharp colour associations. Moving the red object toward the cyan square requires different outputs for different input-zero pixels; this template outputs the same colour for every pixel of a given input colour.
Attempt uses eight-connected enclosure. The required interior contains both 4 and 2 in a marker-dependent pattern, whereas this template fills every enclosed background pixel with one learned colour.

Attempt uses local surroundings to improve on the border flag. Zero components reaching the border become 2 and enclosed components become 5; no available key encodes arbitrary background connectivity to the border.
